description: Lists the MCP sessions Prism is currently tracing — session id prefix, upstream, client name, project, turn and error counts, and age in seconds. Use 'limit' to cap results (default 20, max 100) and 'upstream' to filter by upstream URL substring.

upstream.description: Substring filter on the upstream URL — e.g. 'mcp.acme.dev' returns only sessions relaying to that host.

name: prism_sessions
title: Active sessions
